checks.message: Provisional boundary is prominently disclosed. Organizer data gaps do not block content review; official geometry is required before precision planning, formal recalculation or approval use.
Three required key areas remain provisional and are suitable only for concept review and package checks; replace them before precision design or approval use.
Initial land-use polygons are derived from site boundary partitioning.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, official/local sources and assumptions.
The contract publishes 14 required admission fields, six states, human ownership, non-AI fallback and stop/rollback requirements.
Three pilots each identify local public evidence, a 90-day baseline, non-AI fallback, stop conditions and adopt-or-exit review.
Chinese and English proposal, report, visual, figure and drawing counterparts are present and mapped in the manifest.
